title: Routing Policy Constraints & Preview Wizard
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Build a first-class policy editor flow in Console that lets customers author region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variant rules with live validation and a preview/simulator. The editor should: (1) provide composable predicates (region, customer tier, latency SLO, tagging), (2) present clear default routing stacks (primary model -> cheaper quantized variant -> fallback small model), (3) enforce compatibility checks across deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private), and (4) include a preview/simulator that shows a representative distribution of routed requests, estimated latency and cost delta per rule, and explicit warnings for configuration gaps. This ticket covers the PM scope (requirements, acceptance criteria, rollout plan) and coordination with Design and Eng. Out of scope: runtime policy engine implementation details beyond minimal validation API contract, and multi-tenant billing changes.
acceptance_criteria: Policy editor UI allows customers to add rules for region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants in a single route configuration
Editor exposes composable predicates: region (region list), tier (customer tier/tag), percentage traffic splits, and capacity thresholds
Live validation surface flags incompatible model variants (e.g., model family mismatch, quantization not available in Private deployment) before save

Preview/Simulator provides: sample routing decisions for 50 synthetic requests, estimated token-level cost delta vs baseline, and median latency estimate based on the last 7 days of telemetry per region/model
Export and import of a single-route YAML manifest for infra teams and Private customers
Design review complete and PM sign-off on UX copy and warning language
Integration contract defined with Eng: validation API v1 and preview simulator endpoint; PRs merged for console-side components
Feature gated behind 'routing_policy_editor' flag and hidden until rollout plan completed
